identifier_grammar: ES2015 IdentifierName: ID_Start plus '$' and '_' to start, ID_Continue plus '$' thereafter. Arabic-script letters are valid identifier characters (CORE-1384).

prompt_rules.identifier_rule: All translations MUST be valid JavaScript identifiers -- no spaces, no punctuation. `_` is the only joining symbol; never use `$` in a translation.
prompt_rules.casing_rule: camelCase identifiers stay camelCase, PascalCase stays PascalCase.
